assessment: Only the cited saffron anxiety and depression review mentions saffron. The primary interviews concern dysphagia awareness.
The primary test measured voluntary peak cough flow and dysphagia. Capsaicin appears in discussion of a prior reflex-cough method.
The ketogenic diet used an emulsified MCT supplement. Table 6 has daily off time, dyskinesia and apathy. The comparison changed the whole diet, and off time differs at baseline.
Ginger was one component of the traditional formula. The paper concerns major depressive disorder and network pharmacology, with no isolated ginger effect in Parkinson disease.
Discussion lists caffeine use among possible impulse-control disorder risk factors from earlier literature. There is no coffee-fatigue estimate in this cohort.
Orange describes the arrows in a technology-adoption model figure.
SAGE is the publisher of a cited qualitative research methods book.
Sage appears as the publisher of a cited sourcebook. The Parkinson intervention was auditory cueing.
Sage is a handbook author in the references. The intervention was exercise.
A four-scent olfactory training regimen included eugenol. The trial measured olfaction without assessing pain after ground clove.
Onion is a cited author's surname. This is a cross-sectional motor and cognition study.
Boiled potato served as a diagnostic solid bolus in people with non-neurological dysphagia. The study did not estimate change after baked potato.
Capsaicin appears in the discussion of earlier reflex-cough research. The primary comparison measured remifentanil needed for airway device insertion.
Piperine plus levodopa increased levodopa availability and improved motor assays in lesioned rats. The study supplies no ground black pepper comparison or estimate for the three matched symptoms.
Reviews thymoquinone and other compounds in aging pathways. No original Parkinson symptom outcome after black seed.
Isolated resveratrol was studied in cell, mouse and nematode models, without testing frozen grapes and human rigidity.
Liposomal rosmarinic acid and light were combined in a Parkinson cell model. Sage consumption and freezing of gait were outside the model.

Distilled Japanese pepper tested intranasally in mice improved coordination and pole descent. Those motor assays are adjacent to 0654 and 0827. The other four symptom matches are background or citation mentions.
Isolated resveratrol with and without vitamin D was tested in lesioned mice on locomotion, grip and rota-rod. Frozen grapes and rigidity were outside the intervention and outcomes.

A secondary report from the KIM crossover shows improvement and worsening in fatigue in both diets. It lists the apathy scale with baseline values and gives no standalone apathy comparison. The diet and fractionated MCT oil differ from the frozen exposure.
Curcumin altered cytotoxicity in a cell model. The matched symptoms are clinical background.
CNB-001 is a synthetic curcumin derivative used in an MPTP model. The archived report does not give a culinary turmeric symptom estimate.
Capsaicin was studied for local immune signaling and neuronal survival in an inflammatory rat model. Pain severity after ground cayenne was not assessed.
Curcumin was tested in fruit flies. Locomotion and neuronal endpoints do not supply a culinary turmeric comparison for either frozen symptom.
Reviews experimental curcumin delivery vehicles, including lipid nanoparticles. No original result with the frozen turmeric preparation and endpoints.

Synthesizes trials of pharmaceutical butylphthalide for Parkinson disease dementia. Slowness appears in the introduction and pooled outcomes do not isolate bradykinesia. Primary trial citations warrant follow-up.
Isolated resveratrol reduced levodopa-induced dyskinesia in a rat model. Dyskinesia is a different endpoint from rigidity, and the study did not test grape.
Rosmarinic acid was tested in a rotenone-exposed SH-SY5Y cell model. The experiment supplies no sage or gait comparison.
Reviews saffron and compounds across brain disorders. No original Parkinson fatigue result. The experiment separately tracks the later placebo-controlled trial.
Isolated oleuropein was tested in a rotenone model. The experiment does not measure the listed endpoints under culinary olive oil preparations in Parkinson disease.
